episodes.title: A Father
episodes.summary: Camille heads to Tokyo after receiving an unexpected call from her estranged father.

episodes.title: Sky, Earth, Humans
episodes.summary: Despite her physical aversion to wine, Camille accepts her father's challenge. Issei's family complicates the test for him.

episodes.title: Duel
episodes.summary: Issei gives a journalist stunning information about the competition. Camille thinks she's found the first wine, but verifying it is risky.

episodes.title: Foundation
episodes.summary: Tensions between Camille and Issei escalate. Honoka reflects on her past after getting Hirokazu's note.

episodes.title: The Link
episodes.summary: Issei and Camille puzzle over the second test, which involves a 17th-century painting and mysterious one-word clue.

episodes.title: Legacy
episodes.summary: Camille travels to Italy to solve the painting's riddle, while Issei stays behind to confront his mother.

episodes.title: Food and Wine
episodes.summary: Lorenzo reveals why Luca wanted Camille to oversee the Léger Wine Guide. Meanwhile, Camille and Issei fly to Paris for the third test.

episodes.title: All or Nothing
episodes.summary: Season finale. Camille and Issei come to a realization.

episodes.title: The Present
episodes.summary: Issei and Camille reunite at the Chassangre Estate, only to receive a mysterious gift and set of instructions that will test their bond.

episodes.title: The Quest
episodes.summary: In the aftermath of Issei's near-death experience, he and Camille chase down a crucial clue about the mystery wine.

episodes.title: The Origin
episodes.summary: Tensions rise between Camille and Issei as their search leads them into the Georgian countryside—and a decades-old family feud.

episodes.title: Brother and Sister
episodes.summary: At a high-stakes dinner party, Camille and Issei use their mastery of wine in an attempt to impress a special guest and change Davit's mind.

episodes.title: Trust Me
episodes.summary: Dark memories emerge during Issei's night in the cellar. Tamar lives up to her end of the bargain and agrees to meet with Davit.

episodes.title: The Contest
episodes.summary: Issei returns to Tokyo looking to confront his past. Camille takes a shocking risk that could threaten everything.

episodes.title: Pyrrhus
episodes.summary: Camille's act of deception upends the First Vintage Contest—and her personal life—as Issei struggles with a difficult path to forgiveness.

episodes.title: Break Free
episodes.summary: Season finale. In the fallout of a bitter dispute and family tragedy, Camille and Issei both seek new beginnings.
